Rita (CS): FYI we have a Fjord QBR Tue 10am PT. Need: token runway slide, 2 commit scenarios, onboarding status, and a one-line ask for renewal. Can @Tom - FinOps own the econ numbers?

Tom - FinOps: I can. Quick preference: show (A) committed + what they used YTD, (B) conservative commit increase (10%) with throttles, (C) aggressive commit (25%) w/ sample savings vs on-demand. Will include per-route token breakdown.

usage-bot: USAGE ALERT: account=fjord-123 windows=30d tokens=42,130,487 peak-day=2,980,321 link=https://billing.redwood.example/fjord-123/usage

Lena (SE): Onboarding status: connector ingestion paused by client yesterday after spike. Root cause: missing env vars on prod connector and a mapping rule in transforms. I pushed a hotfix to staging at 09:12 and validated ingest on a 10k row sample. Production fix pending approval from their infra team.

Nikhil (CSM): Customer feedback for QBR: they want (1) justification for commit increase, (2) embed latency SLA for dev env, (3) more granular per-route billing. They asked if quantized variants will break structured JSON outputs.

Tom - FinOps: I'll run a quick delta calc. Command I used to pull raw usage CSV:```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  "https://billing-api.redwood.internal/accounts/fjord-123/usage?window=30d&format=csv" -o fjord-30d.csv
```Also ran:```sql
-- 7d rolling median tokens per route
SELECT route, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY tokens) AS median_tokens
FROM usage.events
WHERE customer_id='fjord-123' AND ts >= now()-interval '7 days'
GROUP BY route;
```

Tom - FinOps: Preliminary sims: scenario A (no change) monthly est = $9.6k. Scenario B (+10% commit) monthly invoice = $10.5k but with fewer throttles -> est $0.9k more predictable spend; Scenario C (+25% commit) invoice = $11.8k and if they move to redwood-q2-small-quant we estimate ~16% cost reduction -> net ~$(11.8k*0.84)=~9.9k -> still ~3% saving vs current but with 25% higher committed spend. I'll attach a short table to the slide. Latency delta for q2-small-quant: +5-9ms median per request on our sample workload.

Lena (SE): I tested q2-small-quant on their structured prompts. Minor differences: numeric rounding sometimes changes last decimal in JSON outputs (should be safe), but a handful of validation rules fail for one route. I'll enumerate routes that need template tweaks. Risk: if we recommend quant during QBR, call out "templating review required".

Nikhil (CSM): I'll draft the commit ask: "Increase monthly commit from 50M to 62.5M tokens for 12mo at current blended rate; Redwood to provide quarterly cost review and 1 remediation run if usage spikes >120% in a month." Thoughts?

Rita (CS): Good start. Two asks before I draft slides: (1) Tom - add a simple chart with last 30d daily tokens and 90d trend, (2) Nikhil - capture customer quote for commit ask (one-liner).

Tom - FinOps: Will do. I'll also create 80/90% Slack alerts and a temporary throttle schedule that reduces ingestion to 50% at 85% commit. I'll post links when ready.

usage-bot: ALERT: fjord-123 threshold=85% will trigger at 2025-06-18T02:30:00Z unless commit changes.

Lena (SE): I'll pause any auto-ingest retries until we have the QBR plan in place. ETA: verify prod env vars + mapping by Mon 15:00 PT.

Nikhil (CSM): I'll ask sales to prepare a 12mo incentive for commit if they sign by EOM. Also will pull customer logs for embed recall examples to include in the deck.

Rita (CS): Owners summary: Tom - FinOps (charts, cost sims, alerts), Lena (SE) (integration + risk notes), Nikhil (CSM) (customer quote + commit ask + sales coord), Rita (CS) (deck + runbook). Reconvene Mon 4:30pm PT for final slide pass. :white_check_mark:
